subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is this PR's local predicate transcript and mocked runner proof enough, or should merge wait for a redacted full-runner/gateway recovery proof for the provider-5xx path?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but the change affects retry, session state, harness contracts, and message delivery; automation cannot decide whether the current proof is sufficient for that semantic risk.

options.title: Require full-runner proof
options.body: Ask for redacted gateway logs, terminal output, or an artifact showing the empty-error retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate side effects before merge.

options.title: Accept current proof
options.body: Treat the predicate transcript and fault-injected tests as sufficient and let ordinary maintainer review decide the remaining code risk.

options.title: Use another candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer the proof and implementation path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 after that PR becomes clearly viable.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted gateway logs, terminal output, or an artifact showing the empty-error retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate side effects before merge.
